name: victim walks out of range, relay holds the frame
comment: Three phones in one netsim scene. The victim starts beside the relay, the
relay stays put between victim and gateway, and at t+20s the victim is
carried 150 units away - far enough that the direct victim-to-gateway link
is gone and anything that still arrives arrived through the relay.
Watch the responder dashboard while this runs: an incident that keeps
updating after t+40s is StoreAndForward and the relay doing their job.
